verdict.rationale: Offering downloadable statutory forms and instructions is a fair question for a national company registry, so the axis applies. The pack contains only two probes recording HTTP 403 at robots.txt on mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in. Nothing was fetched about forms, instructions, or account requirements, so there is no evidence either way of account-free downloads.

support.subject: As a founder, the forms themselves and their instructions are downloadable from the service's site without an account
